description: The keyword groups of the workspace, the default first: how keywords are grouped (a customer, a campaign, a product). A term may be tracked once per group; every keyword belongs to one; get_usage_breakdown by=group says what each cost. externalId finds the group carrying your own id.

externalId.description: Only the group carrying exactly this externalId.

workspaceId.description: Optional. Run this call inside one of your child workspaces (org_..., from list_workspaces) instead of your own. Applies to this call only; the result says which workspace it acted on.

name: list_groups
title: List groups
